answer: Sybil resistance here works because each agent identity must stake a bond that is slashed whenever a duplicate fails the epoch's provenance test, so farming N masks costs N bonds while one honest payout stays fixed. The edge shared across all masks is the giveaway: they reuse one quill and one wallet lineage, and the verifier flags that quill vector, like a single lotus stamped onto many seals, then burns every linked relic at once.
